about: Additional task-fit probes authored from the card contracts before measuring these queries.
Independent of the original golden author, not blind to the corpus or to the known misses.
Whole means a blueprint addresses the requested flow; partial means a reusable node, not an end-to-end solution.
Expected is a relevant target, not a claim that other returned results are irrelevant. No exact-query aliases are warranted.

blueprints.query: restore a stopped batch without repeating completed stages
screen incoming prompts and outgoing replies for unsafe material
turn incoming help requests into answers or a handoff to support staff
collect competing proposals and eliminate weaker candidates over several rounds
choose between inexpensive inference and deeper reasoning based on difficulty
check a proposed patch and wait for its maintainer before merging
trace each step of an existing job and notify someone when it fails
convert free form source documents into validated structured records
repeatedly improve a draft using criticism without showing its writer the scoring rules
investigate a question and substantiate the claims before delivering an answer

cards.query: execute the requested suites on a pull request and return the failing assertions
evaluate submitted work using supplied scoring dimensions and justify each mark
define admission conditions for hypotheses before any are generated
put already scored items in dependency order using a weighting policy
assess urgency impact blocking relationships and cost separately for each item
inspect a completed execution for unsupported calls and out of order steps even if it succeeded
reject a record that violates its schema and name the offending fields
collect worker responses after parallel execution
pause until the maintainer explicitly approves the review
repair a failing test without broad unrelated code changes
send one unchanged question to several reviewers without letting them coordinate
execute untrusted python with a time limit and no network access
